content: Definition of a diagnostic trouble code for the implementa- tion of WWH-OBD The definition of a diagnostic trouble code for the implementation of WWH-OBD implies the existence of a DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds where at- tribute wwhObdDtcClass is set to any value other than demDtcWwhObdClassNoIn- formation .
